snapshot.method_summary: AI DOGE election model (Lancashire-trained, RMSE 1.65) generalised. Pipeline: ward history baseline → national swing dampened 0.65 → LA-level UKD HP v7.0 demographic adjustment → IMD-based deprivation tilt → incumbency (where holders known) → Reform-entry handling → normalisation. Per-LA GE2024 deferred to Stage 1.5, currently uses UK national.

methodology.name: Baseline
methodology.description: Most recent borough result (2025-06-19)

methodology.name: BES MRP Prior
methodology.description: Baseline blended with BES Wave 1-30 south_east prior (weight 15%, n=5565 regional respondents)

methodology.name: National Swing (STM)
methodology.description: Strong Transition Model: multiplicative bounded swing, dampened by 0.1 for local

methodology.name: Demographics
methodology.description: 2 demographic factor(s) applied
factors: Ethnic projections: HP v7.0 May 2026 estimate (Asian 2.3%, White British 87.6%)

methodology.name: Incumbency
methodology.description: No current holder data available

methodology.name: New Party Entry
methodology.description: Reform UK has existing baseline, no proxy needed

methodology.name: Normalise
methodology.description: All shares scaled to sum to 100%

methodology.name: Restrict to ballot
methodology.description: Removed 4 party/parties not standing in 2026 (Britain First 1.2pp, Other 0.0pp, SNP 0.0pp, Plaid Cymru 0.0pp). Their share redistributed pro-rata.

methodology.name: 2025 county-cycle anchor
methodology.description: No 2025 reference available for this council's parent area. Stage 1 uses national polling only.

methodology.name: Reform realignment uplift (no-anchor councils)
methodology.description: No 2025 parent-county anchor available; demographic-borrow rule applied. Asian 1.1% → base target 36.0% × regional multiplier 0.85 = 30.6%. Reform 29.9% → 30.6% (lift +0.7pp). Other parties scaled pro-rata. Calibration source: Burnley 2026 ward-level Asian%↔Reform% relationship (the 2-tier district that did receive the LCC 2025 anchor).

methodology.name: National-share calibration
methodology.description: Aggregate-predicted vs national-polled mismatch corrected at strength 0.65. Multipliers, Labour ×0.74, Conservative ×1.00, Reform UK ×1.16, Liberal Democrats ×0.93, Green Party ×1.12, SNP ×1.00, Plaid Cymru ×1.00.

methodology.description: Most recent borough result (2022-05-05)

methodology.name: BES MRP Prior

methodology.name: National Swing (STM)

methodology.name: Demographics

factors: Ethnic projections: HP v7.0 May 2026 estimate (Asian 7.4%, White British 34.9%)

methodology.name: Incumbency
methodology.description: No current holder data available

methodology.name: New Party Entry
methodology.description: Reform UK estimated at 10.6% from GE/LCC proxy + swing
factors: Already assigned from Step 2 swing: 5.7pp, additional: +4.9pp

methodology.name: Normalise
methodology.description: All shares scaled to sum to 100%

methodology.name: Restrict to ballot
methodology.description: Removed 3 party/parties not standing in 2026 (Plaid Cymru 0.2pp, SNP 0.1pp, Other 0.0pp). Their share redistributed pro-rata.

methodology.name: 2025 county-cycle anchor
methodology.description: No 2025 reference available for this council's parent area. Stage 1 uses national polling only.

methodology.name: Reform realignment uplift (no-anchor councils)
methodology.description: No 2025 parent-county anchor available; demographic-borrow rule applied. Asian 5.3% → base target 35.8% × regional multiplier 0.50 = 17.9%. Reform 17.6% → 17.9% (lift +0.3pp). Other parties scaled pro-rata. Calibration source: Burnley 2026 ward-level Asian%↔Reform% relationship (the 2-tier district that did receive the LCC 2025 anchor).

methodology.name: National-share calibration
methodology.description: Aggregate-predicted vs national-polled mismatch corrected at strength 0.65. Multipliers, Labour ×0.74, Conservative ×1.00, Reform UK ×1.16, Liberal Democrats ×0.93, Green Party ×1.12, SNP ×1.00, Plaid Cymru ×1.00.
